info.title: IBM ecommerce product-service API
info.description: IBM ecommerce e-commerce microservice. All money values are INR.

get.summary: Returns active categories, or all categories for an admin request.
Returns the stock record for a product. Admin only.

put.summary: Sets the stock level for a product. Admin only.

post.summary: Increases or decreases stock by a relative amount. Admin only.

get.summary: Returns a paged, searchable and sortable product list.

post.summary: Natural-language product search with a keyword fallback.

get.summary: Returns type-ahead suggestions for a partial query.
Returns a single product with its current stock level.

Bearer.description: JWT access token returned by the User Service login endpoint.

tags.name: InternalInventory
tags.description:
Service-to-service inventory reservation. The Order Service reserves stock
before charging and releases it if the checkout fails.

tags.name: InternalProducts
tags.description:
Service-to-service catalog endpoints. They are protected by the internal API key
middleware and are never exposed through the public gateway.
